classification.quality_note: Risk factor (FY2011 10-K): Our businesses are highly cyclical, in addition to experiencing some less significant seasonal effects.; no theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a chemicals and refining company on this date. cyclical (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 8.46x; +42% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -2.37; conservative 2yr +6%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (no EPS change in FY11-FY11 to measure: the 0% cap); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS -4.4%/yr (Q1 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 1.4-yr ex-FY10 median

BULL.desc: EPS -4.4%/yr (no FY11-FY11 CAGR to measure: BASE's rate); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS -4.4%/yr (no 2-yr run in FY11-FY11: BULL's rate); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: LYB (retrospective, 2012-06-01) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 8.46x (16.8% downside to Bear $31 / +2.0% upside to Bull $38) | Adj composite 1.40 vs market 3.77: gap -2.37 [OVERVALUED] | +42% above the EPP floor $26 (7x FY12E $3.74) | Conservative 2-yr case: +5.9% total (+3.0%/yr) | At 10.0x FY12E the 15% hurdle price $49 sits above the BULL case; O&P–Americas +23.3% and Intermediates & Derivatives +4.7% operating income in Q1 2012, forward revenues -3% (no FY12 revenue guide in numbers, Q1 2012 revenues as reported); no theme in the registry is live for a chemicals and refining company on this date; none has dated evidence.
